subject: Request: Q1 forecast hygiene — please flag deal risk & update commit
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Jan 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Q1 forecast hygiene — please flag deal risk & update commit

Team,

Finance ran the Q1 rolling forecast this morning and flagged a few gaps between HubSpot and our internal pipeline snapshot. We need a quick hygiene pass on all deals where your name is the AE owner. Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (2027-01-27):

1) Go into HubSpot and confirm stage (P0–P3 mapping) and committed status for any Q1 opportunities.
2) For any active opportunities in Q1, add a risk flag in the deal: RED (material blocker / legal/procurement/PO pending), YELLOW (pricing/PO timeline risk), or GREEN (on track).
3) Attach a brief save-plan for any RED or YELLOW deals (one paragraph + next 3 owner actions). Use the attached SavePlan_Template.docx.

I attached a filtered pipeline snapshot (Pipeline_Snapshot_Q1.xlsx) showing deals currently counted in the forecast and the HubSpot snapshot as of this morning. If you disagree with the forecast inclusion, call it out in the deal notes and ping finance.

Whoever can't complete by EOD Wednesday: flag me and Vivek and we will triage with CS/Legal. This will feed into next Friday's senior forecast review so accuracy matters.

Thanks — quick cadence on this will help avoid embarrassing mid-quarter adjustments.

-naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Pipeline_Snapshot_Q1.xlsx, SavePlan_Template.docx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jan 2027 10:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 forecast hygiene — please flag deal risk & update commit

Naomi — thanks for the heads up. I started a pass this morning and here are the immediate notes:

- ORCH-347 (Orchid Health, Simon Park): Moving from Contracting -> RED. Legal has a data processing addendum they want addressed and procurement requires a vendor assessment; Simon told me they won't sign until Feb 12. I will upload a one-paragraph save plan to the deal tonight and tag Finance.
- ORCH-351: Downgraded to YELLOW due to pricing pushback; prepping an alternative 6-month pilot price.
- ORCH-360: CONFIRMED GREEN; PO expected within two weeks.

I'll update HubSpot by EOD and attach the SavePlan for ORCH-347. Looping Marissa for any cross-sell notes — Marissa, does CS have any outstanding concerns on the ORCH integration?

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
